title: Mưa sao băng chậm
about: Round x9, for sleep with improvised melodies (style ngu-ngon), as the user asked ("tôi muốn những bài âm thanh u tối nhưng dễ nghe để ngủ hơn, có thể thêm những giai điệu ngẫu hứng"): the plucked harp-like string improvising like stars falling one by one, the far choir and the pad under them. B Dorian. Softer harmony than before (added ninths, major sevenths, no Phrygian rub), nothing sudden. An original piece; its melody made up by the improviser in dark/ambient.py.
